1. The 5 Mainstream CCaaS & AI Architectures
Genesys Cloud CX · Amazon Connect · NICE · D365 · Five9
A. Amazon Connect + Nova Sonic / Bedrock
• Pure consumption pricing ($0.018/min + $0.038 AI)
• Zero idle seat fees for seasonal retail/utility spikes
Best_For = Consumption_Elasticity_And_AWS_Shop
B. Microsoft D365 Contact Center + ACS / Voice Live
• Native Teams Phone + Azure OpenAI PTU + Copilot Studio
• Works over third-party CRM (Salesforce / ServiceNow)
Best_For = Microsoft_365_Teams_And_Azure_PTU
C. Genesys Cloud CX / NICE CXone + BYO-Voice-AI
• Best-in-class global WFM, QM & complex skills routing
• Watch out for AudioHook / CXone media-stream surcharges
Best_For = 2,000+ Seat Global WFM/QM Operations
D. Front-Door SBC AI + Existing CCaaS (Hybrid Rec)
• Intercepts 65% of calls at BYOC SBC before CCaaS billing
• Transfers only complex 35% to Genesys/NICE/Five9 seats
TCO_Savings = -46% vs In-CCaaS AudioHook Streaming
2. Deterministic BYOC, CTI Context & Queue Gate
Zero Double-Billing · <150ms Screen-Pop · 0ms Callback
Gate A: Front-Door BYOC Anti-Double-Billing Lock
• Terminates AI-resolved calls at carrier SBC before
entering CCaaS IVR minute/token double-taxation
• Eliminates $0.025/min media-forking tromboning fees
CCaaS_Media_Forking_Tax_On_Deflected_Calls = $0.00
All_In_Per_Minute_TCO_Reduction = -46.2%
Gate B: <150ms CTI Context-Packet & KYC Sync Gate
• Injects `Conversation_Summary + Verified_KYC + Intent`
into Genesys Participant Data / Connect Contact Attrs
• Starts stereo Agent Copilot whisper on transfer
Post_Transfer_Repeat_KYC_Rate = 0.0% (Hard Verified)
Human_Agent_AHT_Reduction = -85 Seconds / Call
Gate C: 0ms Queue EWT>180s Callback & DR Failover
• Checks target skill queue Estimated Wait Time (EWT)
& logged-in agent count before blind transfer
• If EWT > 180s or CCaaS region down, books virtual
queue callback slot or fails over to secondary region
if (targetQueueEwtOver180sOrCcaasRegionDown) -> Callback
Dead_Queue_Abandonment_Rate = 1.1% (vs 24% Blind)

consumption model saves 38% over $150-$240 named seats

• Keep Avaya/Cisco/Genesys seats intact on Day 1 while

• Cuts CCaaS migration timeline from 18 mos to 6 weeks

• All-In Native CCaaS AI Bundle: $248,000 / month
